title: Log in and reach the authenticated area
description: An authenticated staff member can submit valid credentials from the login page and reach the protected area.

steps.description: Navigate to /hospital-bengo/public/index.php
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the authenticated area is displayed

title: Open the configuration page as an authenticated admin
description: An authenticated admin can open the system configuration page from the protected area and see the configuration form.

steps.description: Navigate to /hospital-bengo/public/index.php
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to open system configuration
Verify the configuration form is displayed

title: Update and save hospital settings
description: An authenticated admin can change the hospital name, update the logo, toggle modules, and save the configuration successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /hospital-bengo/public/index.php
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to open system configuration
Fill in the hospital name field with a unique hospital name
Upload a valid logo image
Toggle the system feature switches as needed
Save the changes
Verify a success confirmation is visible
Verify the updated configuration values are displayed

title: Keep saved settings when revisiting configuration
description: An authenticated admin can revisit the configuration page after saving and see the previously saved hospital settings loaded again.

steps.description: Navigate to /hospital-bengo/public/index.php
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to open system configuration
Fill in the hospital name field with a unique hospital name
Upload a valid logo image
Toggle the system feature switches as needed
Save the changes
Open the system configuration page again
Verify the saved hospital name is loaded
Verify the saved module states are loaded

title: Block saving an empty hospital name
description: An authenticated admin cannot save configuration changes when the hospital name is empty.

steps.description: Navigate to /hospital-bengo/public/index.php
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to open system configuration
Clear the hospital name field
Save the changes
Verify a hospital name validation error is visible

title: Reject an unsupported logo file
description: An authenticated admin is prevented from saving a logo upload when the selected file type is unsupported.

steps.description: Navigate to /hospital-bengo/public/index.php
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to open system configuration
Upload an unsupported logo file type
Save the changes
Verify a logo validation error is visible

title: Show the default module states on first load
description: An authenticated admin sees the current default feature switch states when opening the configuration page.

steps.description: Navigate to /hospital-bengo/public/index.php
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to open system configuration
Verify the feature switches are displayed
Verify the current switch states are visible

title: Require authentication for the configuration page
description: A user without an active session cannot access the protected configuration page directly.

steps.description: Navigate to /hospital-bengo/app/views/admin/configuracao.php
Verify access protection is displayed
Verify the configuration form is not displayed

title: Use the documented configuration route exactly
description: The configuration page opens correctly from the documented PHP file route and does not rely on alias routes.

steps.description: Navigate to /hospital-bengo/public/index.php
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /hospital-bengo/app/views/admin/configuracao.php
Verify the configuration form is displayed
